Team / Alex—

We need to lock the high-level roadmap crosswalk for the upcoming QBR. I pulled a first draft timeline and a dependency map and attached both (qbr_raw_timeline.xlsx, dependency_map.drawio). High level goals for this thread:

- Confirm launch windows for the three priority initiatives (Personalization v2, Dedicated GPU autoscaling, Private cloud GA).
- Call out any hard blockers or support work (API freeze, infra migrations, SOC 2 evidence).
- Agree on a single timeline to show execs and a short list of mitigations for each risk.

Action items I need by EOD Wed (28 Apr):
1) Karthik — confirm engineering acceptance criteria and any schedule slippage risks for Personalization v2. If theres anything that requires >2 sprint extensions call it out.
2) Tessa — add customer-facing risk language for Dedicated GPU autoscaling (performance SLAs) and note any migration windows that will impact customers.
3) Lauren — confirm the product dependencies and whether any scope should be de-scoped for the QBR narrative.
4) Vivek — high-level ask for leadership: if we need to push a GA date, what would you recommend we present as the escalation path?

Alex — posting the draft so you can see the proposed customer-facing timeline. If ACME has any constraints (procurement/launch dates) let us know.

Attachments: qbr_raw_timeline.xlsx (timeline spreadsheet), dependency_map.drawio (diagram)

Thanks,
Logan

Logan / all—

Thanks for the draft. Quick notes from eng: 

- Personalization v2: core model integration is on track but the feature flag rollout depends on a KV cache migration scheduled for sprint 11 (starts 12 May). If that migration slips, rollout will shift ~2 weeks. Biggest risk is the cache migration; team is doing a focused spike this week.
- Dedicated GPU autoscaling: infra work is blocked until we finalize the autoscaler tuning experiments. Est. ETA for tuning (pilot) is end of sprint 10 (05 May). Thats the gating item for predictable SLA numbers.
- Private cloud GA: vendor testing for the HSM/KMS integration requires a signed PO from ACME for the on-prem test cluster; we cannot complete external validation without that.

I attached a short note to the draft timeline with sprint-level risk markers.

Karthik
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Following up with risk language and mitigations attached. Highlights: 

- Dedicated GPU autoscaling (HIGH): Potential customer-facing impact if pilot tuning slips. Mitigation: staged rollout with reduced concurrency + mandatory circuit-breaker. Owner: Infra SRE.
- Personalization v2 (MED): Accuracy regressions possible during model swap. Mitigation: canary on 10% of traffic + automated rollback hooks. Owner: Karthik/Models.
- Private GA (CRITICAL dependency on procurement): Add a clear note that on-prem validation will not complete without the signed PO and network access to the test cluster. Recommend we push external GA milestone later in the slide deck if PO timing is uncertain.

Ive attached dependency_map.drawio and a short mitigation runbook (runbook_summary.pdf). Ill add customer-safe language for the QBR slides later today.

-Tessa
